content:
In any industrial process piping installation, pipe fittings represent critical junction points that bear concentrated hydrodynamic pressure, thermal expansion, and mechanical vibration. Selecting substandard fittings or incorrect material grades can compromise entire processing lines and lead to catastrophic leaks.

At Roxy Enterprises, we manufacture and supply prime quality butt-weld fittings conforming strictly to ASME B16.9 and MSS SP-43 in austenitic Stainless Steel (SS 304, 304L, 316, 316L, 321, 310S, 904L), Duplex (S31803 / S32205), Carbon Steel (ASTM A234 WPB), and Alloy Steel (WP11, WP22, WP91). Our production encompasses seamless and welded long radius 90° and 45° elbows, concentric and eccentric reducers, equal tees, reducing crosses, end caps, and stub ends.

For high-pressure instrumentation and hydraulic manifolds, Roxy Enterprises also stocks forged socket-weld and threaded fittings conforming to ASME B16.11 rated for Class 3000#, 6000#, and 9000# service, as well as double ferrule compression tube fittings. Every batch is supplied with complete EN 10204 3.1 & 3.2 Mill Test Certificates verifying chemical composition, tensile strength, and non-destructive hydrostatic testing.

title: Affordable Stainless Steel Plate Manufacturer & Supplier: Selection Guide for Grades 304, 316L, 310S & Duplex
author: Metallurgical Engineering Desk, Roxy Enterprises
excerpt: Learn how to choose the right stainless steel plate grades, hot rolled vs cold rolled finishes, and ultrasonic quality standards for storage tanks, pressure vessels, and architectural fabrication.
content:
Stainless steel plates and sheets serve as the primary structural backbone for chemical reactors, cryogenic storage vessels, desalination evaporators, and food processing vats. Selecting the appropriate alloy grade requires balancing corrosion resistance, mechanical yield strength, thermal scaling resistance, and cost efficiency.

SS 304 / 304L (UNS S30400/S30403) represents the workhorse grade with 18% chromium and 8% nickel, providing excellent formability and resistance in atmospheric and mildly acidic environments. For marine exposures, chloride-rich waters, and sulfuric acids, SS 316 / 316L (UNS S31600/S31603) with 2-3% molybdenum provides essential protection against pitting and crevice corrosion.

When applications require service up to 1100°C, SS 310S (UNS S31008) with high chromium-nickel content prevents scaling and carburization. For extreme stress corrosion cracking environments, Duplex S31803 / S32205 and Super Duplex S32750 offer twice the mechanical strength of standard austenitic grades. Roxy Enterprises maintains vast inventory in thicknesses from 0.5 mm to 150 mm with in-house plasma, water-jet, and CNC laser profile cutting.
quote: Matching the correct stainless steel plate grade and surface finish ensures decades of corrosion-free service life under severe operational demands.

title: Affordable Stainless Steel Pipe Manufacturer & Supplier: Seamless vs ERW Piping for Critical Plants
author: Procurement & Quality Desk
excerpt: A technical evaluation of cold-drawn seamless and electric resistance welded (ERW) stainless steel pipes conforming to ASTM A312, ASTM A358, and ASME SA312.
content:
Piping engineers frequently face the decision between cold drawn seamless (SMLS) and high-frequency welded (ERW/EFW) stainless steel pipes. While seamless pipes provide uniform metallurgical structure without a weld seam factor (E=1.0) for high-pressure cryogenic and sour hydrocarbon transport, precision ERW pipes offer exceptional wall thickness uniformity and economy for large diameter distribution headers.

Roxy Enterprises stocks and supplies both seamless and welded stainless steel pipes in ASTM A312 Grades TP304, TP304L, TP316, TP316L, TP321, TP347, TP310S, and TP904L. Sizing spans from 1/8" NB to 24" NB across Schedules 5S, 10S, 40S, 80S, 160, and XXS. All pipes are hydrotested, eddy current inspected, and pickling-passivated with strict compliance to ASTM dimensional tolerances.
quote: Choosing between seamless and welded stainless steel pipes balances pressure containment ratings with project procurement economics.

title: Durable Stainless Steel Flanges Manufacturer & Supplier: Standards, Ratings & Pressure Classes
author: Piping Stress Analyst
excerpt: A detailed technical overview of Weld Neck, Slip-On, Blind, and RTJ flanges conforming to ANSI B16.5, ASME B16.47, and EN 1092-1 from Class 150 to Class 2500 LBS.
content:
Flanges provide demountable joints that enable inspection, maintenance, and modification of piping systems without cutting pipe spools. In high-pressure and high-temperature service, the choice of flange face (Raised Face, Flat Face, or Ring Type Joint RTJ) and flange style dictates the sealing integrity of the entire plant.

Weld Neck Flanges (WNRF) feature a tapered hub that transfers stress directly to the pipe, making them the gold standard for severe cyclic temperatures and pressures up to Class 2500 LBS. Slip-On Flanges (SORF) offer easy alignment and lower initial cost for utility lines. Blind Flanges (BLRF) and Spectacle Blinds allow positive isolation during hydrotesting and shutdown maintenance.

Roxy Enterprises manufactures forged flanges in SS 304/L, SS 316/L, Duplex S31803, Super Duplex S32750, ASTM A105 Carbon Steel, and Inconel 625. Serrated spiral or concentric gasket face finishes conform strictly to ASME B16.5 roughness standards (125-250 AARH).
quote: Accurate flange facing and forging integrity prevent joint leakage under fluctuating pipeline thermal cycles.

reviews.name: Girish Kulkarni
reviews.text: We procured Class 600# RTJ flanges in SS 316L from Roxy Enterprises. Flange face serrations and bolt hole PCD were 100% accurate as per ASME B16.5.
